reasons: Claimed status is compliant, and consistent with that the finding proposes no redline and no counterparty comment — the paragraphs are returned unchanged, which is the expected output for a compliant classification.

The cited text supports the conclusion: Section 4.5.1 gives AbbVie the sole right (not obligation) to Manufacture and supply, Section 6.2 payments are event-triggered milestones, and Section 3.6 allocates development costs per responsible Party — none is a minimum purchase, take-or-pay, shortfall penalty or volume cap on Customer.

Rationale correctly notes the rule's scope limit (commitments running from Harpoon to us are out of scope) and correctly treats the only 'minimum' hits (insurance limits) as irrelevant, so the clause sits at the preferred position rather than merely the fallback.
No deterministic check failures and no over-flagging risk, since nothing is being raised as a negotiation issue; the finding functions only as internal evidence.
